notFound.title: Page not found
notFound.body: The link may be wrong, or the page may have moved.

error.title: Something went wrong
error.body: Please try again. If it keeps happening, come back later.

targetBand.title: Which band score do you need?

levelCheck.title: Find your level
levelCheck.body: A short level check shows where you are now and what to practice first.

comingSoon.title: The level check is being prepared
comingSoon.body: It will be available here soon. Your goal is saved on this device.

storage.unavailable: Your answers can't be saved on this device. Don't close this page.

mode.practiceDetail: No time limit. Mark evidence for your answers.
mode.examDetail: 60 minutes, like the real test. No help. The time keeps running if you leave.

evidence.title: Your evidence
evidence.limit: You can pin up to {max} sentences to one question.

passage.label: Passage. Use the arrow keys to move between sentences, Enter for actions.

finish.title: Finish the test?
finish.unanswered: {count, plural, one {# question has no answer.} other {# questions have no answer.}}

timer.label: Time left: {time}
timer.warning: {minutes, plural, one {# minute left} other {# minutes left}}

exitExam.title: Leave the test?
exitExam.body: The time keeps running while you are away.

reading.wordLimit: {max, plural, one {This answer has more than # word.} other {This answer has more than # words.}}

results.title: Your results
results.honest: A practice score on our own practice test. It is not an IELTS band score.
results.rechecked: Rechecked after a correction to the answer key or to how answers are checked. Your earlier result was {score} of {total}.
results.recheckedSameScore: Rechecked after a correction to the answer key or to how answers are checked. Your score is the same; some answers or notes changed.
results.importedFromM4: You finished this test before the app checked answers. It was checked when you first opened these results.
results.storageUnavailable: Your results can't be saved on this device. They will be lost if you close or reload this page.

none.title: No results on this device yet
none.body: Results appear here after you finish the test on this device.

results.oldVersion: This test has changed since you took it, so a detailed review is not available.
results.cannotCheck: This test has changed since you took it, so your answers can't be checked.
